cobble_poke_bank.configuration.title: Cobble Poke Bank Configuration
Configure the database settings for the mod.
If true, the mod will use a MySQL database for storage. If false, the mod will use a local SQLite database for storage.
Configure the MySQL database settings for the mod.
The hostname or IP address of the MySQL server.
The port number of the MySQL server.
The name of the MySQL database to use.
The username to use when connecting to the MySQL server.
The password to use when connecting to the MySQL server.
The timeout in milliseconds for connecting to the MySQL server.
cobble_poke_bank.configuration.permissio: Configure the permissions for the mod.

The permission level required to use the '/pokebank' command.

cobble_poke_bank.configuration.server.to: Configure the server settings for the mod.
cobble_poke_bank.configuration.server.ba: Configure the server bank settings for the mod.
The maximum number of slots a player can have in their bank.
If true, players will not be allowed to deposit fainted Pokemon into their bank.
If true, players will not be allowed to deposit Pokemon with held items into their bank.
If true, players will not be allowed to deposit Legendary Pokemon into their bank.
If true, players will not be allowed to deposit Mythical Pokemon into their bank.
If true, players will not be allowed to deposit Ultra Beasts into their bank.
Configure the blacklist for Pokemon that are not allowed in the bank.
cobble_poke_bank.configuration.server.he: Configure the held item restrictions for the mod.
If true, only items that are officially tagged as held items will be allowed in the bank.
If true, held items that are not allowed in the bank will be automatically stripped from the Pokemon when deposited.
Configure the blacklist for held items that are not allowed in the bank.

cobble_poke_bank.configuration.server.me: Configure the server messages for the mod.
Configure the text parser for the server messages.
The prefix to use for all messages sent by the mod.
Configure the location labels for the server messages.
The label to use for the deposit location in messages sent to players.
The label to use for the withdraw location in messages sent to players.
cobble_poke_bank.configuration.server.co: Configure the command messages for the mod.
The message to send to players when the database is unavailable.
The message to send to players when the player is not found.
The message to send to players when they try to deposit a Pokemon with a held item that is blacklisted.
The message to send to players when there are no blacklisted Pokemon configured.
The message to send to players when they try to deposit a Pokemon that is currently in battle.
The message to send to players when the server configs have been reloaded.
cobble_poke_bank.configuration.server.da: Configure the database messages for the mod.
The message to send to players when the server is loading data from the database.
The message to send to players when the server fails to load data from the database.
The message to send to players when the server encounters invalid Pokemon data in the database.
cobble_poke_bank.configuration.server.de: Configure the deposit messages for the mod.
The message to send to players when they try to deposit a Pokemon that is missing.
The message to send to players when the server fails to save their Pokemon to the database.
The message to send to players when they try to deposit a Pokemon but their bank is full.
The message to send to players when the server fails to remove their Pokemon from the PC after depositing it into the bank.
The message to send to players when they successfully deposit a Pokemon into their bank.
cobble_poke_bank.configuration.server.wi: Configure the withdraw messages for the mod.
The message to send to players when they try to withdraw a Pokemon that is missing.
The message to send to players when the server fails to read their Pokemon data from the database.
Failed to Remove From Bank Message
The message to send to players when the server fails to remove their Pokemon from the bank after withdrawing it.
The message to send to players when they try to withdraw a Pokemon but their PC is full.
The message to send to players when they successfully withdraw a Pokemon from their bank.
cobble_poke_bank.configuration.server.va: Validation Messages
Configure the validation messages for the mod.
Edit
No Held Items Message
The message to send to players when they try to deposit a Pokemon with a held item that is not allowed.
Officially Tagged Held Items Only Message
The message to send to players when they try to deposit a Pokemon with a held item that is not officially tagged as a held item.
Blacklisted Held Item Message
The message to send to players when they try to deposit a Pokemon with a held item that is blacklisted.
Blacklisted Pokemon Message
The message to send to players when they try to deposit or withdraw a blacklisted Pokemon.
No Legendary Pokemon Message
The message to send to players when they try to deposit a Legendary Pokemon into their bank and Legendary Pokemon are not allowed.
No Mythical Pokemon Message
The message to send to players when they try to deposit a Mythical Pokemon into their bank and Mythical Pokemon are not allowed.
No Ultra Beasts Message
The message to send to players when they try to deposit an Ultra Beast into their bank and Ultra Beasts are not allowed.
No Fainted Pokemon Message
The message to send to players when they try to deposit a fainted Pokemon into their bank and fainted Pokemon are not allowed.
Auto-Stripped Held Item Message
The message to send to players when they try to deposit a Pokemon with a held item that is not allowed and the held item is automatically stripped.
